google_review_notes: No login required. Tap Play on the main menu to start level 1. Drag on the board to aim (the dotted line shows the path and where the bubble will stick), release to shoot; tap the launcher to swap with the next bubble. Fireball, Bomb and Rainbow boosters are in the bottom bar. Daily puzzle, Level Select (with Endless at the end), Shop and Settings are on the main menu. Casual game with AdMob ads and optional in-app purchases; no account, chat or user-generated content.
apple_review_notes: No login required. To test IAPs, open Shop from the Bubble Shooter main menu; Restore Purchases is in Settings. Start level 1 with Play: drag to aim, release to shoot. No demo account needed.
